description: This file defines the Drupal form class 'FieldStorageAddForm' used for adding and configuring field storage in the Drupal 'field_ui' module. It includes methods for building the form, validation, submission, and managing temporary storage of field configurations.

classes.name: FieldStorageAddForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for adding new field storage configurations, supporting AJAX interactions and temporary storage of field settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies and setting configuration factory.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form array for adding a new field storage, including form elements and AJAX settings.

methods.name: buildGroupForm
methods.description: Adds form elements for selecting a field type from a group.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates form input, ensuring required fields are filled and field names are unique.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, redirecting to the next step.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Generates the URL to redirect after form submission.

methods.name: ajaxSubmit
methods.description: AJAX callback for form submission, handling validation errors or success.

methods.name: successfulAjaxSubmit
methods.description: Handles successful AJAX submission by opening a modal dialog.

methods.name: getNewFieldDefaults
methods.description: Retrieves default options for a new field based on preconfigured presets.

methods.name: setTempStore
methods.description: Stores field configuration data temporarily for later editing.

methods.name: fieldNameExists
methods.description: Checks if a given machine name for a field already exists.

methods.name: rebuildWithOptions
methods.description: Rebuilds the form when options are changed.

methods.name: startOver
methods.description: Resets the form to initial state.
